### Fixed
- **`gpt-oss-20b` and `gpt-oss-120b` answer after Ready: the harmony renderer reads its tiktoken encodings from the model image** (giantswarm/agent-platform#606). vLLM's harmony renderer loads the `o200k_base` and `cl100k_base` encodings at the first request, from `openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net` unless `TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE` names a local directory. The serving namespace has no egress to that host, so both presets reached Ready and then answered every chat completion with HTTP 500 (`HarmonyError: error downloading or loading vocab file`). The presets now serve the model images that carry both files under `/models/tiktoken` (`giantswarm/models/gpt-oss-20b:6cee5e81ee83-7abb6426`, `gpt-oss-120b:b5c939de8f75-7abb6426`: the same checkpoint layers plus one layer with the encodings at their pinned sha256, giantswarm/models#13) and set `TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE=/mnt/models/tiktoken`. The pod stays offline.
